project.name: data_analysis
project.description: 从原始数据到可视化看板的分析管线

agents.name: Data Analyst
agents.role_goal: 分析数据集，产出包含关键统计、趋势和行动建议的摘要报告。
acceptance_criteria: Must mention the number of rows analyzed

agents.name: Visualization Designer
agents.role_goal: 基于分析报告设计可视化方案：选择图表类型、配色、轴映射。
acceptance_criteria: Must specify at least 2 chart types
Must reference data from the analysis report

agents.name: Dashboard Builder
agents.role_goal: 生成带 Chart.js 的完整 HTML 看板。
acceptance_criteria: Must be valid HTML with proper structure
Must have at least one canvas element
